userObservations.trayQuit: application window stays for several seconds; desktop remains responsive

quitDiagnosis: Production before-quit prevents closing windows until owned native stop and grant revocation settle
quitFix: Close owned renderer windows, upload media sandbox and tray immediately, stop polling, then wait in the main process for both cleanup drains, including a failed drain; this fixture does not measure real voice shutdown

quitRegression.before: FAIL main window must close before drains resolve
quitRegression.after: PASS immediate UI retirement, single-flight cleanup and both success/failure drains settle before exit

detailsScope: Self has no remote-member voice relation; remote member observations remain independently scoped and require fresh selected media evidence
privacy: No user profiles, member identifiers, credentials, raw machine logs or screenshots included
